title: Daily Devotional #25
paragraphs: As I read through Matthew Chapter 25 today, I was struck by the powerful message of stewardship and service that is present throughout the chapter. From the parable of the ten virgins to the story of the talents, there is a consistent message that we are to be good stewards of the gifts and resources that You have given us.

The first story about the ten virgins highlights the importance of being prepared for Your return. The wise virgins were prepared with oil for their lamps, while the foolish ones were not. This parable reminds me that I need to be diligent in my preparation for Your return, so that I am ready to meet You when the time comes.

The second story about the talents emphasizes the importance of using our gifts and resources wisely. The servant who buried his talent was rebuked, while the ones who invested their talents were rewarded. This parable challenges me to consider how I am using the resources that You have given me to serve Your kingdom.

Lord, as I reflect on these parables, I am reminded that You have entrusted me with many gifts and resources, and that I am called to be a faithful steward of them. Help me to be wise and diligent in my preparation for Your return, and to use my gifts and resources to serve Your kingdom in the most effective way possible.

I pray that You would give me the wisdom and discernment that I need to use my gifts and resources in a way that is pleasing to You. I ask that You would use me to be a blessing to others, and that You would help me to be faithful in all that You have called me to do.

Thank You for Your grace and mercy, and for the many blessings that You have given me. May Your name be glorified through my life, and may I be a faithful servant who hears Your words, "Well done, good and faithful servant!" when You return.
In Jesus' name I pray, Amen.
